decisions.reader_note: For 2023–2025, Akebia uses net loss as its EPS numerator, including 2025 when it reported operating income but a net loss. Potential common-share equivalents are excluded as anti-dilutive. The excluded-share table gives counts before applying the treasury-stock method; these are not additions to the weighted-average denominator. The statement heading scales dollars, not shares. Full share counts and EPS retain scale-zero tags without changing the reported values.

decisions.reader_note: For 2023–2025, Fastly uses net loss as its EPS numerator and excludes potential dilution in the loss periods. Its policy separately applies the if-converted method to convertible debt, alongside potential equity-award and employee-purchase dilution. Excluded instruments are not added to the denominator. Statement and EPS-note share counts are in thousands with scale-three tags, while EPS uses scale zero. Original dates, units and values are retained.
